sec1.deptSub: International Collaboration Department - FPT University (Global FPTU)

sec2.title: 2. International Collaboration Department (IC-FPTU)
sec2.sub: FPT University's Gateway to Global Knowledge
sec2.historyP1: The International Collaboration Department (IC-FPTU) was established to expand strategic academic, research, and corporate partnerships worldwide for FPT University.
sec2.historyP2: Driven by the 'Go Global' mission, IC-FPTU actively connects FPTU students with global opportunities (Outbound) while welcoming international faculty and students to Vietnam (Inbound).
sec2.support1: International Visit Reception: Itinerary planning, airport transfers, meeting room arrangements, and diplomatic gifts.
sec2.support2: Student Exchange Programs: Managing semester exchange, international internships, Summer School, and Study Tours.
sec2.support3: Partnership & MOUs: Facilitating Memorandum of Understanding (MOU/MOA) agreements and joint dual-degree programs.
